pros: Easy-to-use designer for creating visually appealing email campaigns.
Powerful automation features for event follow-ups and reminders.
The all-in-one platform simplifies managing various communication needs.
cons: Navigation to core features can be cumbersome due to a deep menu structure.
Occasional performance issues or slow loading times were a minor frustration.
Billing policies or contact limits could be confusing for a small business.
